problem: edge-selection QUBO, diamond graph, 5 qubits, QAOA p=1, 1024 shots
controlled: identical QUBO, QAOA depth, optimized parameters, shots, decoding and objective across all backends; only hardware and transpilation differ
conclusion: All three real IBM QPUs decoded the TRUE optimal path [0,2,3] and matched the classical optimum exactly. Feasible sampling rate degraded under hardware noise relative to the noiseless simulator (19.82% ideal vs 12.30-18.65% on hardware). This validates the encode/submit/decode pipeline on real quantum hardware. It is NOT evidence of quantum advantage: a classical exact solve returns the same answer in microseconds.
